metadata_schema_v1.implementation_hash_semantics: source files read at export time; not an immutable execution snapshot
metadata_schema_v1.policy: Preserve historical files and trace contents. Do not assign the current Git commit or execution hash retrospectively.

metadata_schema_v2.execution_version: Captured once at task creation and persisted with the task
metadata_schema_v2.implementation_hash: Alias for execution_version.implementation_hash; null for unknown legacy or not-started requests
metadata_schema_v2.replay: The source execution snapshot is preserved, even after code or exporter changes
metadata_schema_v2.git_worktree_dirty: Includes evidence and documentation changes; not equivalent to implementation changes
